text: The square where the four gate streets meet. Stalls ring it on market days, round the well and the market cross.
An open arcade on stone posts, where traders keep their stalls out of the rain. The council meets in the timber hall above.
The parish church, its long nave facing east to a round apse. The west tower carries a slate spire that travellers see from the river road.
The lord's keep, a square stone tower with corner turrets, inside its own curtain wall with four round towers. Its gatehouse faces the town.
A stone wall rings the town, with a tower every few stretches and a gatehouse at each of the four gates. Torches burn at the gates until the curfew bell.
